name: AACarabiner
tagline: AAC's first product, prototype to shelf.
about: AACarabiner is the first physical product released under Artistic Area Club, designed together with Ján Šefárik. The idea came from a simple observation: the club lived entirely online, and we wanted something people could actually carry, an object for those who are into underground culture but still expect style and function from what they use. We shaped it as a carabiner, 3D printed from nylon, with an organic silhouette pulled straight from AAC's visual language. From there it turned into a long loop of prototyping, printing a version, handing it to people, then coming back weeks later to ask what held up, what got in the way, and what they stopped using. Every round of feedback reshaped the geometry until the piece carried keys the way it should and survived everyday wear. What started as an internal experiment ended as a finished product on sale, and a way for the community to carry the brand with them.

name: maturuj.com
tagline: Exam prep app, from idea to running business.
about: maturuj.com began as a final school project with an unusual brief: build something worth keeping after graduation, a real product we could sell. Together with Adam Demian we went through the entire cycle, from the first idea and project planning to development, testing, and launch. The app prepares students for the Slovak school-leaving exam through personalised AI feedback. It holds digitised SJL and English exam papers, exercises covering the topics students struggle with most, and an assistant that explains why an answer is right instead of only marking it wrong. It answers a problem most students know well, they drown in endless notes while the education system moves slowly, so the exam becomes something to survive rather than learn from. I led the design side, tone of voice, branding and logo, the UX/UI of the app, and the sales materials. It is live, bootstrapped, and running as a working business.

name: WEZEO Rebranding
tagline: Rebrand clarifying what the team stands for.
role: Logo Design, Content Creation, Art Director
about: Led WEZEO's strategic rebrand together with another designer, redefining how the team communicates its purpose and values. The goal was not to create a prettier logo but to clarify what build different truly means. By shaping the brand's messaging, visual direction, and internal system, we built a scalable identity that reflects how WEZEO designs, collaborates, and grows as a team. The result is a coherent brand ecosystem that connects design thinking with everyday practice, clear, purposeful, and rooted in craft.

name: Pro podnikavé Redesign
about: Co-led design direction for ProPodnikavé's platform and app redesign, turning a slow, web-only experience into a mobile-first tool that fits how small entrepreneurs actually work day to day. I focused on rebuilding the information architecture, simplifying navigation, and refining core flows so users could quickly find key resources on both web and mobile. Together with the product and development teams, we defined a clear design system and interaction patterns that work consistently across devices, driving a 40% increase in returning users and making the app a reliable part of their daily routine.

name: Bicykľáreň
tagline: Bike rental brand, naming to art direction.
role: Logo Design, Content Creation, Art Director
about: I created the Bicykľáreň brand from the ground up, from naming and logo to art direction, as a sub-brand of Tilia Resort that still feels like part of one team. We kept the resort's colors and typeface while giving Bicykľáreň its own, more personal voice. The handwritten wordmark drawn in one continuous stroke suggests smooth riding and an easy, straightforward rental process, without extra visual clichés like a bike icon. To keep the brand clear for visitors, we added the functional descriptor Bicykľáreň – Bike Rental as a flexible secondary lockup.

name: Cabana coffee & bakery
tagline: Café identity built to scale into a bakery.
about: I developed a rebrand for a café that aimed to refresh its visual identity and scale its business by expanding into a bakery. The main challenge was a tight 24-hour deadline to deliver a complete solution, but despite the time pressure, the project was successfully completed and the outcome proved worth the effort. The new logo became a core element of their brand and is now used consistently across their communication, with both the client and customers responding positively to the fresh, authentic visual direction.

name: Stelinhome
tagline: Guesthouse site built around the owner’s dog.
about: I developed a website for a client seeking an appealing online presentation for his guesthouse. The communication approach was built around his beloved dog, which I incorporated into the logo and social media assets to create a personal and memorable brand image. Additionally, I designed a versatile template for consistent and systematic brand presentation across all digital platforms. This project focused on building a strong and relatable identity for a local business, engaging its audience through thoughtful storytelling and cohesive visual design.

name: Artistic Area Club
tagline: Identity for a creative collective of artists.
role: Logo, Visual Identity, Poster Design, Content Creation
about: Artistic Area Club is a creative collective of selected artists and designers who represent the brand's core values, humility, freedom, and inspiration. It serves as the umbrella under which original designs, music, visuals, and creative projects are produced. In short, it's an elite creative unit that shapes the brand's identity and pushes the boundaries of creativity.

name: Logofolio
tagline: Logos shaped around different brand identities.
about: This is a logofolio showcasing logos designed for various clients, each tailored to different brand identities and needs.

name: Posterfolio
tagline: Posters for a range of clients and events.
about: This is a poster folio featuring poster designs created for different clients and events, each tailored to unique themes and purposes.

name: ÆRv Cover Series
tagline: Album artwork anchored by a custom logotype.
about: I designed album cover art in a dark style, with a custom logotype as the main symbol. The project also included vinyl design, maintaining strong visual consistency across all assets.

name: Oravska Kniznica
tagline: Digital and print design for a public library.
about: I was responsible for digital communication and visual content creation for a public library located in Dolný Kubín. My work focused primarily on producing static social media posts that highlighted important events and engaged the local community. Additionally, I designed posters, diplomas, and prepared various materials for print, ensuring all assets were consistent with the library's visual identity. Through careful design and planning, I helped the library strengthen its brand, improve audience outreach, and present its activities in a clear and visually appealing way.
